test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The curved surface area of a solid circular cylinder of height 12 cm is 2640 cm². What is the volume (in cm³) of the cylinder? (Take π = 22/7)
solution:
**Given:**

Height of cylinder (H) = 12 cm

Curved surface area of cylinder = 2640 cm²

**Formula used:**

Curved surface area = 2 × π × R × H

Volume of cylinder = π × R² × H

Where, R = radius; H = height

**Calculation:**

Curved surface area of cylinder = 2640 cm2

⇒ 2 × π × R × H = 2640

⇒ (22/7) × R × 12 = 1320

⇒ 12 × R = 60 × 7

⇒ R = 35 cm

The volume of cylinder = π × R2 × H

⇒ (22/7) × (35)² × 12

⇒ 22 × 5 × 35 × 12 = 46200 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 46200 cm3.**
